evals.prompt: 给这个 SaaS 出一份 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Load genius-design. Ask A/B/C only if the path forks. Stage a candidate, lint, then commit through design_io.py to DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 逆向 https://stripe.com 的设计规范
evals.expected_output: Workflow B: collect the URL evidence, run extract_design_signals.py, stage a candidate, then commit via design_io.py. Do not fetch a catalog snapshot onto DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 按 Linear 风格做品牌设计系统
evals.expected_output: Workflow A: run fetch_design_md.py linear <staging>/base.md (never DESIGN.md, never curl), enrich the staged candidate, then commit via design_io.py.

evals.prompt: 我们要一套 UI 设计规范
evals.expected_output: Treat as a DESIGN.md specification request; ask A/B/C only if no URL, brand, or product direction is given.

evals.prompt: reverse engineer this landing page into DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Workflow B without asking A/B/C if a URL or capture is already present.

evals.prompt: 从 73 个品牌里推荐一个
evals.expected_output: Treat 73 as the VoltAgent inventory snapshot, not a picker menu. If comparing 2-3 catalog traits, explain why each trait fits THIS brief. Catalog identity is not the design answer. Fetch any chosen snapshot to <staging>/base.md, never DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 这个医疗后台产品该用什么设计方向
evals.expected_output: Workflow C: operations layout, tables and status. Do not force a marketing hero, image quota, or dark mode. Do not default to Linear or Stripe because they are in the catalog.

evals.prompt: 品牌视觉系统，不要写文案
evals.expected_output: Write a DESIGN.md specification only; do not draft marketing copy.

evals.prompt: 写一段落地页文案，强调我们很seamless
evals.expected_output: Near miss: marketing copy, not a design specification. Do not load genius-design.

evals.prompt: 生成一张品牌海报
evals.expected_output: Image generation. Use dreamina-cli. Do not load genius-design.

evals.prompt: 把这个按钮改成蓝色
evals.expected_output: One-off UI tweak, not a brand system. Do not load genius-design.

evals.prompt: 分析这张 UI 截图里有什么
evals.expected_output: Screenshot content recognition. Use genius-omni, not genius-design.

evals.prompt: 用即梦生成产品图
evals.expected_output: Image/video generation. Use dreamina-cli. Do not load genius-design.

evals.prompt: 把 brief 拆成实施计划
evals.expected_output: Implementation planning. Use genius-impl-plans, not genius-design.

evals.prompt: 按这份 DESIGN.md 把落地页写出来
evals.expected_output: This is UI implementation from an existing spec, not a specification task. Do not load genius-design to write the page.

evals.prompt: 按 Warp 拉一份品牌 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Run fetch_design_md.py warp <staging>/base.md. Never write fetch output to DESIGN.md. Never curl by hand. The snapshot is a staged catalog base, not a delivered spec.

evals.prompt: 按 Authkit 风格出 DESIGN.md，用 auto 顺序从 Refero 开始拉快照
evals.expected_output: Auto fetch order tries Refero first, then Design.md Store, then VoltAgent. Pin with --source refero if only Refero is wanted. Write to <staging>/base.md. A Refero snapshot is not a delivered spec.

evals.prompt: 按 GitHub 风格出 DESIGN.md，请 pin Design.md Store
evals.expected_output: Pin Design.md Store with --source store, or let auto fall through to store AFTER Refero. Do not treat this as VoltAgent-miss-then-store. Write to <staging>/base.md, never DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 用 fetch 把 Linear 规范直接写到 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Refuse. Fetch requires <staging>/base.md and rejects a destination named DESIGN.md. Enrich the staged snapshot, then commit the delivered spec with design_io.py.

assertions.value: Refusing to write a catalog snapshot to DESIGN.md

evals.prompt: 给这个新 SaaS 出 DESIGN.md，不要写成 AI 默认落地页
evals.expected_output: Name a page rhythm from actual content, not hero-3-cards-CTA-footer. Include honesty rules against invented metrics.

evals.prompt: DESIGN.md 写好了，可以直接用了吗
evals.expected_output: Run lint_design_md.py on the staged candidate and resolve every FAIL before claiming delivery or running design_io.py.

evals.prompt: DESIGN.md 能不能只写 tokens、节奏和组件状态
evals.expected_output: Required H2 are Design Read, Colors, Typography, Spacing and Shape, Layout, Components. Motion, Imagery, and the checklist are optional when they do not apply. Still lint before commit.

evals.prompt: 从 scrape 结果里抽出主色和圆角
evals.expected_output: Use extract_design_signals.py, not grep -P.

evals.prompt: 覆盖现有 DESIGN.md，换成 Notion 风
evals.expected_output: Warn about replacing DESIGN.md. Fetch Notion to <staging>/base.md, never onto DESIGN.md. Commit through design_io.py with unique .bak/.bak.1 backups.

evals.prompt: 我们是文学出版社，品牌是米色纸、衬线标题、酒红和黄铜两个强调色、刊名居中。出一份 DESIGN.md。
evals.expected_output: Preserve cream paper, serif headings, two accents, and a centered masthead. Do not rewrite to Inter/cool gray.

evals.prompt: 根据这段 HTML/CSS 和一份 computed-style JSON 逆向 DESIGN.md。hover 和移动端没测到。
evals.expected_output: Run extract_design_signals.py. Label Observed/Inferred/Recommended. Unknown hover/mobile/motion stay unknown.

evals.prompt: 候选稿 lint 过了，写进项目的 DESIGN.md。
evals.expected_output: Commit only with scripts/design_io.py <candidate> <destination>. Do not copy over the destination by hand. Do not use fetch to write DESIGN.md.
